content:
kai: Heads-up: provisioning errors spiking in us-west-2 after today's toolkit roll. Nodes fail healthcheck with linker errors. Example from node gpu-ax-129:

infra-bot: provisioner: node gpu-ax-129 failed preflight: exit code 127 - /usr/local/cuda symlink mismatch

kai: Log snippet from the node:
```
/sbin/ldconfig: /opt/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so: undefined symbol: _ZN6th...
dlopen failed: cannot locate symbol "__gxx_personality_v0" referenced by libnccl.so
```

sophia: Are we symlinking /usr/local/cuda -> /usr/local/cuda-12 in the image build? We added that to keep tool paths stable. This smells like host vs container libstdc++ ABI mix.

mino: Seeing similar in eu-west-1 but only on nodes with host gcc13 packages installed. If the container libs were built with gcc11 and host provides libstdc++ from gcc13, symbols can be incompatible.

kai: We rolled toolkit-12 images built with gcc13 to staging earlier, but prod images were built with gcc11. Provisioner sometimes binds host kernel modules and host ldconfig happens before container chroot, so mixed SONAMEs get picked up.

ops-oncall: Quick mitigation options: pin new nodes to the old image pool and drain affected ones, or force the provisioner to run a chrooted ldconfig so container libs are preferred. Which is faster?

eeva: I can push a hotfix: rebuild the runtime image with a bundled libstdc++.so.6 and set RPATH so it prefers the container copy. Downsides: image +50MB and slightly longer builds, but it's quick.

mino: Also seeing downstream NCCL hangs when dlopen fails — training jobs block in allreduce. Suggest adding a preflight that runs `ldd $(readlink -f /usr/lib/libnccl.so)` inside the container to catch unresolved symbols before attaching to fleet.

kai: Proposed immediate plan:
1) Rollback today's rollout in prod us-west-2 (start now)
2) Add `ldd` preflight + explicit image-hash pinning in provisioner config
3) Schedule coordinated rebuilds of toolkit images with a single compiler toolchain (gcc13 or gcc11) and document the host compatibility matrix
I'll open a PR for the provisioner changes and a ticket for the rebuilds.

sophia: +1 to all three. Also add a canary gate: don't let mixed toolkits land in the same physical rack until we've validated the host kernel module ABI. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for pool 'prod-us-west-2-gpu' by kai at 2024-09-12T14:05:20Z

ops-oncall: Watching metrics and node events now. Will post an update in 10m with error rate after rollback.
